nodes.description: mapping(bytes32 => AdProgram) holding every ad program: owner, delegate, token, renter, startPrice, rentStartBlock, adURL and newRentalsAllowed flag.
mapping(address => uint256) per-owner counter used to derive unique program ids in createAdProgram.
Length in blocks of an adspace rental/auction, default 50000*7 and overwritten by the constructor argument.
Attacker controlled caller address; becomes program owner, renter and the subject of every access-control comparison.
Creates a new ad program keyed by keccak256(msg.sender, nonce) and writes it into adPrograms.
Rents an existing adspace, refunds the previous renter, pays the payment delegate via external token transfers and then mutates adPrograms state.
Owner-only setter for the payment delegate address of an ad program.
Owner-only toggle that enables or disables new rentals for an ad program.
Owner-only price setter, only allowed when no remaining value is owed to the previous renter.
Owner-only token address setter, only allowed when no remaining value is owed to the previous renter.
View helper returning the blocks left before the current rental expires based on block.number.
View helper checking that an ad program exists by testing its token against address(0).
Computes the pro-rata refund still owed to the current renter using 2 * startPrice * blocksRemaining / adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.
Computes the premium owed to the program owner: startPrice/2 + startPrice * blocksRemaining / adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.
Deployment constructor that sets adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks from the supplied argument.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
Receive hook that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
External IERC20 transferFrom paying the remaining adspace value back to the previous renter before state is updated.
External IERC20 transferFrom paying the rental premium to the payment delegate before state is updated.
Multiplication/series of arithmetic operations 2 * startPrice * blocksRemaining / adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks in getRemainingAdspaceValue.
Arithmetic startPrice/2 + startPrice * (blocksRemaining / adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks) in getAdspaceRentalPremium.
Token address parameter of createAdProgram.
Initial start price parameter of createAdProgram.
Program name parameter of createAdProgram.
Initial advertisement URL parameter of createAdProgram.
Ad program identifier parameter of buyAdspace.
Token address parameter of buyAdspace, checked against the stored token.
Maximum amount parameter of buyAdspace, compared against remaining value plus premium.
New advertisement URL parameter of buyAdspace.
Ad program identifier parameter of setPaymentDelegate.
New payment delegate address parameter of setPaymentDelegate.
Ad program identifier parameter of setNewRentalsAllowed.
Boolean flag parameter of setNewRentalsAllowed.
Ad program identifier parameter of setPriceForAdspace.
New start price parameter of setPriceForAdspace.
Ad program identifier parameter of setTokenForAdspace.
New token address parameter of setTokenForAdspace.
Constructor argument that becomes adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.
Local copy of msg.sender inside createAdProgram.
Locally derived program id keccak256(from, nonce).
Local copy of msg.sender inside buyAdspace, later written as the new renter.
Refund amount computed by getRemainingAdspaceValue and forwarded to the previous renter.
Premium amount computed by getAdspaceRentalPremium and forwarded to the payment delegate.
Blocks remaining returned by adspaceTimeRemaining inside getRemainingAdspaceValue.
Blocks remaining returned by adspaceTimeRemaining inside getAdspaceRentalPremium.
Computed expiration block rentStartBlock + adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.

edges.reason: msg.sender is captured and used as the program owner in createAdProgram.
msg.sender is assigned to the local from in createAdProgram.
Local from is consumed by createAdProgram to build ownership and the program id.
createAdProgram writes the new AdProgram struct into adPrograms.
createAdProgram reads and post-increments adProgramNonces[from].
Derived programId is used as the mapping key into adPrograms.
createAdProgram computes the local programId.
createAdProgram calls adspaceIsDefined before and after storing the program.
token parameter flows into the stored AdProgram.
startPrice parameter flows into the stored AdProgram.
programName parameter flows into the stored AdProgram.
initialUrl parameter flows into the stored AdProgram and the event.
msg.sender is assigned to the local from in buyAdspace.
Local from is written into adPrograms as the new renter.
programId parameter selects the ad program to buy.
token parameter is compared against the stored token value.
tokens parameter is compared against the required payment.
adURL parameter is stored into adPrograms and emitted.
buyAdspace requires adspaceIsDefined(programId).
buyAdspace calls getRemainingAdspaceValue to size the refund.
buyAdspace calls getAdspaceRentalPremium to size the premium.
Return value of getRemainingAdspaceValue is stored in local remainingAdspaceValue.
Return value of getAdspaceRentalPremium is stored in local rentalPremium.
Attacker-influenced refund amount is passed directly into the external token transferFrom call.
Premium amount is passed directly into the external token transferFrom call to the delegate.
Malicious token can re-enter buyAdspace from the transferFrom refund while state is still stale.
Malicious token can re-enter buyAdspace from the transferFrom premium before renter and price are updated.
buyAdspace mutates renter, adURL, startPrice and rentStartBlock in adPrograms after the transfers.
adspaceTimeRemaining result is stored as blocksRemaining in getRemainingAdspaceValue.
adspaceTimeRemaining result is stored as blocksRemaining in getAdspaceRentalPremium.
getRemainingAdspaceValue calls adspaceTimeRemaining.
getAdspaceRentalPremium calls adspaceTimeRemaining.
getRemainingAdspaceValue performs the multiplication/division computation node.
blocksRemaining feeds the 2 * startPrice * blocksRemaining product.
Result of the arithmetic computation becomes remainingAdspaceValue.
getAdspaceRentalPremium performs the premium arithmetic node.
blocksRemaining feeds the premium division and multiplication.
Result of the premium arithmetic becomes rentalPremium.
adspaceTimeRemaining reads rentStartBlock from adPrograms.
adspaceTimeRemaining reads adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.
expirationBlock is computed with adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.
expirationBlock is compared with block.number and returned by adspaceTimeRemaining.
getRemainingAdspaceValue reads startPrice, renter and token from adPrograms.
getAdspaceRentalPremium reads startPrice, renter and token from adPrograms.
adspaceIsDefined reads the token field of adPrograms.
setPaymentDelegate compares msg.sender with programOwner as its only authorization.
setPaymentDelegate writes paymentDelegate in adPrograms.
setPaymentDelegate calls adspaceIsDefined.
programId parameter selects the ad program to modify.
delegate parameter is written into adPrograms.
setNewRentalsAllowed compares msg.sender with programOwner.
setNewRentalsAllowed writes newRentalsAllowed in adPrograms.
setNewRentalsAllowed calls adspaceIsDefined.
programId parameter selects the ad program to modify.
allowed parameter is written into adPrograms.
setPriceForAdspace compares msg.sender with programOwner.
setPriceForAdspace writes startPrice in adPrograms.
setPriceForAdspace calls adspaceIsDefined.
setPriceForAdspace requires getRemainingAdspaceValue(programId) == 0.
programId parameter selects the ad program to modify.
newPrice parameter is written into adPrograms.
setTokenForAdspace compares msg.sender with programOwner.
setTokenForAdspace writes token in adPrograms.
setTokenForAdspace calls adspaceIsDefined.
setTokenForAdspace requires getRemainingAdspaceValue(programId) == 0.
programId parameter selects the ad program to modify.
newToken parameter is written into adPrograms.
_timeBlocks argument flows into the constructor body.
constructor assigns _timeBlocks to adspaceAuctionTimeBlocks.
